denial.payer_remark: Service not medically necessary. Minimum 6 weeks conservative therapy required prior to advanced imaging.

visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-03-15
Patient: 57-year-old male with acute lower back pain radiating to bilateral lower extremities onset 10 days ago.
Neurological exam: Patellar reflexes 1+ bilaterally. Progressive right lower extremity weakness noted; right dorsiflexion strength 2/5 (foot drop).
Sensory: Decreased sensation in perianal distribution (saddle anesthesia). Patient reports new onset urinary hesitancy and incontinence since yesterday.
Assessment: Acute cauda equina syndrome suspected. Emergent lumbar MRI ordered immediately.
Treating Clinician: Marcus Stone, MD.

expected.rationale: QUIL-COV-2.2 supports a lumbar MRI without the 6 weeks of conservative treatment when low back pain comes with a neurological deficit or bowel or bladder dysfunction. The examination documents a progressive motor deficit, saddle anaesthesia and new urinary symptoms.
